ops.reason: Both rules hold the EPF/IPF requirement that participants stay at the official competition hotel for the whole competition; the 2026 restatement is just one version of the requirement that the other rule tracks through 2027.

Both regulate the same 50 euro coach accreditation fee and coach limit at EM/VM; the other rule already holds decisions under the subject 'Trænerakkreditering ved EM og VM', so the 2026 decision is a version of the same rule.
